description_en: Modifies the synchronization objects in a data synchronization job instance. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版修改数据同步作业实例中的同步对象
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-synchronization-object --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtskfq1149w2540000 --synchronization-objects DBName_:_dtstestdata --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySynchronizationObject

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en: The modified synchronization objects. The value is a JSON string that supports certain regular expressions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141901.html
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的同步对象，格式为JSON串且支持一定的正则表达式，详细说明请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141901.html
parameters.name: synchronization_objects

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationObjectModifyStatus]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49452.html） operation based on this parameter to query the status and progress of the synchronization object modification
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，您可以根据此参数调用[DescribeSynchronizationObjectModifyStatus]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49452.html）接口查询同步对象变更的状态及进度
